notes:
{知識|ちしき} refers to information and understanding acquired through learning or experience.

- {知識|ちしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧: to expand one's knowledge
- {知識|ちしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}につける→身につける：03158_minitsukeru⟧: to acquire knowledge
